title: Going from 99% to 98% water can halve a potato pile's mass
body: Imagine 100 kg of potatoes that are 99% water. Their dry parts weigh 1 kg. If drying raises that unchanged 1 kg to 2% of the total, the pile now weighs just 50 kg.
takeaway: A one-point change can be enormous when it doubles the share of the smallest component.
visual: a heap of potatoes on a rustic balance scale
